review.reviewBody: I used to spend hours every week ordering food. Now it's simple, super easy, and I have free time to spend on other aspects of my restaurant.

@graph.name: Three steps, and your Aptean setup stays as it is
@graph.description: It starts with a single file from you and ends with kitchens ordering from their phones.

step.name: Send us one export from Aptean
step.text: A spreadsheet is usually all we need: the items every kitchen buys and what it pays, under your own codes.

step.name: We set up the guides and invite each kitchen
step.text: Your guides go in, each account is opened, and each kitchen gets the app on its phone. Most kitchens place a first order the same day.

step.name: Kitchen-checked orders start landing
step.text: Each one comes in approved by the kitchen, with its number and time stamp, in the format you set.

@graph.name: Do I need an Aptean alternative before kitchens can place orders out loud?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Aptean can stay the ERP for your whole food business, with its traceability, catch weight pricing and recall tools. The kitchens who phone your desk can say their orders into our app instead.

@graph.name: Is VoiceOrder Solutions better than Aptean?

acceptedAnswer.text: At one job: bringing in the order from a kitchen that would rather call than log in to a portal, approved by that kitchen before your desk sees it. Everything that happens to the order after that is Aptean's work, not ours.

@graph.name: Which Aptean products does this page cover?

acceptedAnswer.text: The food ones: Aptean Food & Beverage ERP and its editions, Produce Pro Software from Aptean, and Aptean Ignition, which serves distributors and processors of food. Aptean also sells ERPs for consumer goods, apparel and manufacturing. If you want an Aptean alternative for one of those, nothing here describes it.

@graph.name: Aptean can build an AI agent for email orders. Why add an app?

acceptedAnswer.text: Aptean does build custom agents, and one published case covers incoming order emails: after each run it reports the assumptions it made and anything it could not resolve, for your staff to look at. That helps with emailed orders. Our app is for chefs who would otherwise phone: each one says what is needed into the app and approves it before the order leaves. Other companies also sell AI that turns phoned and voicemailed orders into written ones, so we are not the only option.

@graph.name: Who decides the swap when an item is short?

acceptedAnswer.text: Aptean does, as it does today: your team settles each substitution, split case or backorder in Aptean. VoiceOrder Solutions passes on what the kitchen ordered, as the kitchen approved it, and makes no swap of its own.

@graph.name: Does anything link Aptean to VoiceOrder Solutions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nothing is built in. The two are sold apart, and each of us supports only what we make. Where your Aptean system accepts EDI or API orders, ours can arrive that way with no retyping; the demo is where you find out whether it does. By email, you get the order as an attached file, each line approved by the kitchen, and your staff work from that list rather than from a call or a voicemail.

@graph.name: What will this cost, and when can we start?

acceptedAnswer.text: Setup takes 24 to 48 hours for most distributors. We never need an Aptean login, and nothing gets installed: we start from a spreadsheet of your accounts' items. Moving to EDI or the API later is a separate step, and we walk through what it needs on your side in the demo. Aptean asks you to request pricing, and we quote every distributor on its own, so neither puts a price on its website.

@graph.name: Where do the Aptean details on this page come from?

acceptedAnswer.text: From aptean.com, read on 9 November 2026: the food distribution and food ERP pages, Produce Pro, Ignition, the AI agent pages and a press release on an email-order agent. The web portal details also draw on a third-party software listing. Aptean publishes no prices, so we state none. If Aptean has updated a page since then, tell us and we will correct this one.
